name: Option C — baseline + virtual hotspot sensor
description: Software-only: same hardware as baseline. BMS runs a nominal thermal model of the pack, corrected by the 2 edge NTCs, and derates on the estimated hotspot; allows ~1C when the pack is cool.

assumptions.text: BMS MCU can run a 130-node thermal model at 0.5 Hz (no BOM change)
Observer uses nominal cell parameters and equal current sharing; robustness checked for ±30 % cooling-model error
